notes: VAT standard rate (taux de droit commun) 18% (DGI synoptic table, CGI art. 339 et seq.). The DGI's art. 355 exemption list and the 9% reduced-rate list contain no gold or precious-metal item, so jewellery and bullion take 18% (absence-of-exemption basis, disclosed). Import duty HS 7108 null: the DGD online tariff line could not be opened on an official page.

sources.name: Direction Générale des Impôts - Impôts et taxes en Côte d'Ivoire (synoptic table, éd. 2025)
